card.title: Prove We’re Close
card.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to the reunion with me. Let them see us arrive holding hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They still think we're just friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I want us to trust each other in that room too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time someone asked, you let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll introduce you as my partner. Will you keep hold while I say it?

mechanism: A asks B to risk public recognition of their partnership and offers a visible reciprocal commitment after prior withdrawal.
confusable: Unlike merely asking for affection, A must request a social risk that demonstrates trust together.
comparison: D80-a asks held hands during a public introduction; D80-b asks an awkward deleted message after revealing private need.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
